This implies that 4-(Diaminomethylideneamino)Butanoic Acid may act through a chain of targets, possibly modulating the activity of SDR family members, which in turn could interfere with replicase function. The evidence suggests a possible mechanism where the drug influences the viral replicase polyprotein through indirect interactions, possibly by targeting enzymes involved in viral replication.
